verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only general internal linking between notes and automatic link updates when a file is renamed. One community remark mentions dropping whole notes inline into a session note. Nothing documents referencing or transcluding an individual block or section of a note, or keeping such an embed in sync, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reference or transclude an individual block or section of one note inside another and have it stay in sync
